services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Private charters are a great way to connect with friends, family, and coworkers. Whether you're a fishing club or creating an incentive for employees, a fishing trip on the Stardust or the Coral Sea is sure to make everyone happy. Our attentive crew will take care of each passenger from sign-in to farewell; you can be certain every need will be met. We reserve the right to make whatever changes in any given trip that circumstances dictate, including cancellation for under-subscriptions, changes in the itinerary due to weather or other conditions, unavailability of a boat, or substitution of a boat as deemed necessary. Departure and return times may vary. All prices are subject to change

blurb: Guests can book private fishing charters with Stardust Sportfishing, enjoying modern fish-finding equipment, comfortable seating, and clean facilities. The location is in Santa Barbara Harbor, near Stearn’s Wharf and the Maritime Museum. They also host community events such as Fish For Life, providing complimentary fishing trips for special needs children.
